meta.name: dwarven_forge_hold
meta.prompt: A dwarven forge-hold cut into the flank of a volcano: a great gate in the cliff face, terraces of stone halls climbing beside it, forges glowing at the edge of a lava channel, and a stair down toward the magma.

programs.brief: A colossal dwarven hold gate carved directly into the dark volcanic cliff face: twin towering stone dwarf statues holding warhammers flanking a massive reinforced archway with glowing magma runework, anvils, and braziers.
A heavy stone and blackstone forge facility straddling the edge of the lava channel: stone sluice gates tapping liquid magma, huge anvils, iron grates, and chimneys puffing black smoke.

tokens.terrain: a steep volcanic flank with an active lava channel and magma basin below
tokens.icons: a monumental hold gate carved into the basalt cliff face; glowing forges lining the edge of the lava channel; grand stairs descending toward the magma; terraced stone halls climbing the rock slope

root.label: The volcanic forge-hold of Karak Magma
